remarks: Welcome to Rowayton Woods! Conveniently located just minutes from the charming village of Rowayton. This beautifully appointed 2 bedroom 1 bath unit is bright with cathedral ceilings and a large open living/dining room, hardwood floors, and a cozy wood burning fireplace. The spacious kitchen has marble countertops, stainless steel appliances and shaker style cabinets. Enjoy coffee or a cocktail on the deck overlooking peaceful views of the scenic pond. Amenities include an in ground pool and tennis court along with a fabulous community garden! The unit comes with assigned parking and separate secure storage area. *SELLER HAS PAID THE 10 YEAR $14,000 SPECIAL ASSESSMENT IN FULL MAKING THIS  MONTHLY HOA ESPECIALLY ATTRACTIVE.
